title: How Do Trees Pull Water Hundreds of Feet High?
topic: How trees pull water hundreds of feet high
description: Discover how giant trees lift water from their roots to their highest leaves without using a mechanical pump. You will learn how transpiration, xylem tubes, and the cohesion-tension mechanism pull water up against gravity. Subscribe and follow us for more.
